summary.text: Frank Farry is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania State Senate, representing District 6 since December 1, 2022, after serving in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from 2008 to 2022; he is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Eileen Hartnett Albillar. He is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Frank Farry earned a B.S. in economics from the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School in 1995, a master's degree in public policy from Rutgers University in 1998 and a law degree from Rutgers in 2000.

He worked as an assistant township manager for Middletown Township from 2000 to 2008 and, since earning his law degree, as an attorney for Jackson, Cook, Caracapp, and Bloom, according to Ballotpedia.
Farry also volunteered as a firefighter and chief of the Langhorne-Middletown Fire Company.
Farry represented House District 142 from 2008 to 2022, and his Senate predecessor in District 6 was Republican Robert Tomlinson.
For 2025 and 2026 he chaired the Institutional Sustainability and Innovation committee and was vice chair of the Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure Committee.
